title: Co’s ex-bodyguard testifies delivering cash-filled suitcases to 4 residences linked to Romualdez
summary: An ex-bodyguard of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co testified that he took part in delivering cash-filled suitcases, which he called “basura,” to four residences associated with former House Speaker…

blocks.text: An ex-bodyguard of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co testified that he took part in delivering cash-filled suitcases, which he called “basura,” to four residences associated with former House Speaker Martin Romualdez on several occasions from 2023 to 2024.
